description:
Port test/extensions-input-event.test.ts (~10 test cases). Exercises:
- Input transformation (text modification preserving images)
- Image replacement when provided
- Handler chaining (transforms accumulate across handlers)
- Short-circuit behaviour (handled stops subsequent handlers)
- Source field handling (interactive, rpc, extension)
- Error handling (catches and continues)
- Handler existence detection

InputTransform reference extension already ported — this tests the dispatcher-level chaining logic that underlies it.
title: Port extensions-input-event tests (transform, handled, chaining)
